Download a table, save it, and read it back, or read the saved copy

fetch_cached.Rd

Scripts download their data on a full run and reread it on a rerun, so the rerun works offline and gives the same numbers. fetch_cached() does both. fetch downloads the table; path is where the copy is kept.

Usage

fetch_cached(path, fetch, mode = c("refresh", "missing", "offline"), ...)

Arguments

path

CSV file that holds the saved copy. Its folder is created if needed.

fetch

function with no arguments that downloads the table and returns a data frame, e.g. function() get_series_exp(324).

mode

  • "refresh" (default): download, save to path, and read the saved file back.

    • "missing": download only when path does not exist yet; otherwise read it. For large files that change rarely.

    • "offline": only read path; stop if it does not exist.

...

passed to readr::read_csv(), e.g. col_types.

Value

the table, as read from path

Details

The table is always read back from the file, also right after a download, so a full run and a later offline rerun see identical values. readr writes numbers so that they read back exactly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
from_disk <- FALSE
hist <- fetch_cached(
  "data/raw/324.csv",
  function() get_series_exp(324, rename = "no"),
  mode = if (from_disk) "offline" else "refresh"
)
}
